text: {"assertions":["A lock timeout issue occurred in storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql on 2026-01-20 during database migration.","The lock timeout only affected accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation that could be reproduced against a loaded table.","The problem manifested as a lock wait condition that triggered a statement timeout, causing cold start performance to degrade by 98% to 813ms.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query rather than lazily loading it.","The fix was submitted in PR #5064 on the fix/lock-timeout-1 branch.","This lock timeout occurred in the same area of code as earlier lock timeout work."]}
